findings.issue: The env-write step inlines secret/var values into the ssh stdin via single-quoted heredoc fragments like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'. If a future Anthropic key shape ever contained a literal single quote, the inline form would break apart and either misassign or fail. Current Anthropic keys (sk-ant-api03-…) are alphanumeric + [_=.-], so this is theoretical, but worth flagging for the future. Mitigation if it ever appears: switch to read -r off stdin (opaque per-line) or to a fixed sentinel-delimited block.
findings.suggestion: Document the assumption inline ('values are alphanumeric + [_=.-]') or add a defensive check: `[[ "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" == *\'* ]] && { echo '::error::API key contains single-quote — refusing to write'; exit 1; }`. Defer unless the assumption breaks.

findings.issue: The heredoc terminator EOF on line 182 sits at YAML-block-scalar indent level 10. After YAML strips the common leading indent (the run scalar `|`), EOF ends at column 0 and matches as expected. This is correct, but is brittle to future indentation edits (mixing tabs/spaces, deeper nesting). YAML lint passes today.
findings.suggestion: No action — current YAML lint is clean. Worth a comment near the run block if anyone refactors indentation.
